olga: heads-up I opened a small docs PR to align streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go and include a checkpoint helper so iterators don't restart at page 1 after transient failures. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513

trevor: can you paste the compact Python sync snippet here?

olga: sure:

olga: ```python
# python sync iterator with checkpoint preservation
from redwood import RedwoodClient
from redwood.docs_utils import resume_pages_sync

client = RedwoodClient()
checkpoint = None
for page in resume_pages_sync(lambda token: client.stream_pages(page_token=token), checkpoint):
    process(page)
    checkpoint = page.next_token
```

mike: looks good. add a one-line note about persisting checkpoint to Redis if cross-process resume is needed. also include exponential backoff with jitter in the helper.

docs-bot: Lint: docs/snippets/streaming.md: MD034/no-bare-urls - wrap PR link.

olga: wrapped link and fixed formatting. pushed commit.

ci-bot: running checks... integration:examples:python: passed. merging once reviewers approve.

mike: approved. thanks olga.

olga: will follow up with a short migration note for teams with custom resumers.
